held.noManage: Changing the cutting loss needs planning.leather.manage (the planner).
held.noProposal: There is no proposal to decide.
held.inDraft: This loss is in the draft revision already.
held.waitsForDraft: Accepted: it waits for a draft revision of the style (Products starts it).
held.dismissedAlready: Dismissed already: it comes back when it changes or more cuts come in.
held.reasonShort: Say why, in at least 3 characters.
held.noProposalHides: No hides to propose: read the plan again.
held.noDraftPo: A draft purchase order needs purchasing.manage (the buyer).

requirement.ORDERED: This plan line is ordered already.
requirement.IGNORED: This plan line was set aside in What to buy & make.

held.noNote: A note on the order needs threads.post.
held.notMustBuy: Only a line that must buy has a draft purchase order.
held.busy: Wait: the last action is still going.

keys.draftPo: Draft PO for a Must buy line
keys.nextOrder: Next and previous order in the drawer

row.openShade: Can {order} be cut from one shade?
row.draftPo: Draft PO (as What to buy & make)

need.title: Leather need per order
need.purpose: Area and hides per order and style, and whether one shade covers it.
need.error: Couldn't load leather need per order

noRun.title: No plan run at this site yet
noRun.body: The need is read from the latest plan run: Run plan now.

need.emptyBody: The latest plan run found no leather planned by the hide for an open order.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.body: No row matches the search or the filters.

protectors.title: Certified protectors
protectors.purpose: Armour planned only from part numbers certified for that style (EN 1621).
protectors.substituteHeld: Not certified for style {style} — the DoC would be wrong.

yield.title: Planned vs actual yield
yield.purpose: Learn the real cutting loss per style from the cutting logs.
yield.purposeSince: Learn the real cutting loss per style from the cuts since {date} (at least {min} per style).
yield.error: Couldn't load planned vs actual yield
yield.empty: Not enough cuts yet to learn from (needs {min} per style)
yield.trend: Actual loss per work order of {style}
yield.acceptedWaiting: {to} accepted · waits for a draft revision

shade.title: Can this order be cut from one shade?
shade.gone: This order line is no longer in the plan run.

why.COVERED: Nothing left to find: what is issued and reserved covers the order, from one shade lot.
why.FITS: One shade lot covers what is left: reserve its hides and the order stays one shade.
why.SPLIT: No lot covers it alone, but each garment can come from one lot: the garments stay one shade, the order does not.
why.MUST_BUY: The free stock does not cover it, not even split by garment: buy the area that completes the best lot.
why.ASK_CUSTOMER: The order already holds hides of more than one shade lot: only the customer can accept the mix.

shade.grades: Grade mix of the free hides
shade.own_one: the order's own lot · {count} hide free
shade.own_other: the order's own lot · {count} hides free
shade.noOptions: Nothing to choose: the order is covered.
shade.mrpLine: the line in What to buy & make

option.buyEffect: Buy {area} (≈ {hides} hides) of {shade} to complete lot {lot}: the same Draft PO as What to buy & make
option.askEffect: A note on {order} for Sales: they ask the customer whether a mix of shades is fine

accept.title: Change cutting loss for style {style}
accept.affects: Affects the next plan run and new quotes; a released order never changes.
accept.intoDraft: It goes into revision {revision} (draft): its planned hide yield and its leather wastage. Released revision {released} and its work orders stay as they are.
accept.noDraft: {style} has no draft revision: the change is recorded, and Products starts revision {next} to carry it (accept again then).
accept.back: Accept another proposal later, or change the draft in Products

dismiss.title: Dismiss the proposal for {style}
dismiss.body: The proposal stays quiet until it changes or more cuts come in. The reason is kept in the style's history.
dismiss.reasonHint: 3 to 500 characters, for example: a new die since last week.

ask.head: Ask the customer: {order} line {line} ({style}, {colour}) cannot be cut from one shade lot.
ask.split: We can cut each garment from one shade: {split}.
ask.buy: Or we buy {area} of shade {shade} first.
ask.question: Please ask the customer whether a mix of shades between garments is fine, and note the answer here.

notice.drafted: Draft purchase order {orders}: open it in Purchase orders.
notice.acceptedIn: {style}: the new cutting loss is in revision {revision} (draft).
notice.acceptedRecorded: {style}: the new cutting loss is recorded; it waits for a draft revision.
notice.ran: The plan ran: the need is read again.
notice.runBusy: A plan run of this site is going: try again in a moment.

refusal.moved: The proposal changed meanwhile (new cuts or another decision): the yield is read again.
refusal.shade: Refused: another shade lot than the order's (one shade lot per order). Choose another option.
refusal.draft: The style's draft revision changed: read the yield again.
refusal.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile: it is read again.
refusal.gone: It is not there any more.
refusal.failed: It did not work: try again.

error.forbidden: Your role may not see it.

print.title: Cut plan
print.noFilters: Every open order line that needs leather
